phase.description: Integer or half-step float in 0–7 (2.5, 5.5). D-029.

tier.description: Proof tier (default t1). D-024: tier:t3 is verified only by a passed @pytest.mark.t3 test; skipped/xfailed/T1 siblings never verify it.

demo.description: R4-9 §3.2 rule 3 — repo-relative artifact path(s) for verify: demo. Each must exist and be non-empty; a directory must hold at least one non-empty file. Absent = fallback to conformance/demos/phase-N.md with a warning.

gate.description: R4-9 §3.2 rule 4, tightened by round-5 F3 — a Makefile target that enforces a verify: checklist / static-gate requirement, is a prerequisite of `review-round`, and is invoked by at least one workflow step. Workflow step names are not gate values. Required once the requirement's phase is due; missing or unresolvable = uncovered (red unless waived).

text_hash.description: R4-9 §3.2 rule 6 (review3 §Q3) — sha256 of this requirement's source section body in docs/plan/. Recomputed on every run; a mismatch is red and prints the linked test ids as the re-review list. Re-pin with `python conformance/check.py --print-text-hashes`.
